method: Root viewed both rendered PNGs with view_image; parsed both SVGs as XML.
checks: Colored curves and black dashed joint frontier are visible.
Legends, labels, axis units and footnotes are readable with no clipping.
p50/p95 insets clearly separate C1 current-engine medians.
Only existing endpoints connected; unmeasured interiors and non-executable joint segment explicitly disclosed.
Source summary medians/ranges rederived from all26 process observations; independent agent recomputed per-engine and joint frontier sets.
No new benchmark, confidence interval, full frontier sweep, or global-fastest claim.
limitations: Small process min-max ranges are visually smaller than some endpoint markers.
Strict point-estimate frontier is not a significance claim.
